opening.argument: The presentation expressly urges viewers to acquire Bitcoin, hold it, and wait for its value to rise, while also promoting paid cloud mining under a one-year contract by describing its returns as “really good.” Those are direct solicitations tied to projected appreciation and returns: viewers are told, “Buy it and hold it” and to get “some bitcoin if you haven't got it yet,” while Hashflare is presented as offering “really good” returns. The disclaimer and uncertainty about the one-million-by-2020 timeline limit the claims, but they do not remove the observed promotion of Bitcoin acquisition and paid mining based on expected upside.
